values.value: Finds: Bundle Product2 records (SBQQ__ConfigurationType__c set) with no SBQQ__ProductOption__c child rows. Why it matters: An empty bundle adds no value at quote time — the sales rep sees a parent SKU with nothing to configure, and the customer pays for a wrapper instead of components. Often a sign of half-finished bundle migrations. Suppress a finding: when the bundle is a deliberate "header" SKU that exists only for reporting or contract grouping and has no configurable options. Disable the detector: only if your org sells bundles built dynamically via product rules rather than static option lists. Most orgs should leave this on.
